item.artDescription: An engraving on this furniture resembles <color=#D09B61FF>a megaspider</color> being murdered by <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> without emotion or expression. <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> wears a feral expression. The work is infused with the idea of kindness and is done in a minimalistic style. Unusually for this kind of work, the subjects are in front of nine town guards. This illustration relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> mutilating <color=#D09B61FF>the megaspider</color> in close combat on 3rd of Jugust, 5502.

This furniture is engraved with an image of <color=#D09B61FF>Jaegwang Sim</color> huddled in the shade of a basin with red dry skin. Eight unmoving wombats surround the scene. This depiction tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Jaegwang</color> overheating on 10th of Decembary, 5501.
This furniture bears an illustration of a monster eating a cabbage. The work is shaded in hues of green and black.

This furniture is engraved with a depiction of <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> overcoming <color=#D09B61FF>a megaspider</color> with a gladius with quick, efficient movements. Six pheasants look on. The work reminds the viewer of sadness. This artwork relates to the slaying of <color=#D09B61FF>the megaspider</color> by <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> with a gladius on 3rd of Jugust, 5502.
An engraving on this furniture portrays the minor celebrity Octave. A miller to the right of the main scene makes the viewer think of chaos.

This furniture bears a depiction of <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> packing supplies for a journey with an eager look in her eyes. Six dancers watch from a distance. The image is bordered by a thousand comedians. This depiction relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> forming a caravan on 4th of Decembary, 5501.

This furniture is engraved with an illustration of <color=#D09B61FF>a spelopede</color> being mutilated with a gladius with cold efficiency. <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> is baring her teeth. Almost every shape in the image seems to be static. This illustration refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> murdering <color=#D09B61FF>the spelopede</color> in melee with a gladius on 3rd of Jugust, 5502.
This furniture bears an artwork of a solitary ant moving to the right near a grassland. The subjects are in front of thousands of lentils.
This furniture bears a depiction of a hoof. The work is shaded in hues of black and green. The scene takes place inside a village built near a cove.
An engraving on this furniture portrays a triangle.

This furniture bears a depiction of <color=#D09B61FF>Zero 'Maker' Tachikoma</color> trudging through sand with red dry skin. The scene takes place inside a blazing desert. The image contrasts combat with hunger. Though few would expect it, a terrorist waits to the left of the main scene. This illustration refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Maker</color> overheating on 10th of Aprimay, 5502.
This furniture bears a depiction of a wing. There is a donkey beneath the main subject.

This furniture bears an image of <color=#D09B61FF>Zeyu 'Zihao' Fu</color> searching for water while vomiting. The scene appears to take place inside, next to a heater. The whole image is depicted by the careful arrangement of dozens of hearts. The work is executed in a romanesque style. This artwork tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Zihao</color> overheating on 10th of Aprimay, 5502.
An engraving on this furniture shows a star surrounded by cones. The image somehow expresses both elegance and unrest. Though few would expect it, the subjects are in front of dozens of onions.

This furniture is engraved with a representation of <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> capturing <color=#D09B61FF>Smog Dedmen</color> with obvious pleasure. <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> is kicking <color=#D09B61FF>Smog</color> for no obvious reason. The well-balanced structure of the image almost conflicts with its hyper-realistic style. This depiction refers to the capturing of <color=#D09B61FF>Smog</color> on 13th of Aprimay, 5502.

This furniture is engraved with an illustration of <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> thinking as others look on. In the distance, a fletcher observes. The scene takes place inside a city built near a cave. The work has a dadaist feeling and a focused structure. This representation relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color>'s caravan receiving a demand on 8th of Decembary, 5501.
This furniture is engraved with a representation of an archaeologist eating a bell pepper. A deer fades in in the upper part of the image.

This furniture is engraved with a portrayal of a cecropia tree. The work is infused with the idea of torment and is done in a purist style. If you squint your eyes, the triangular composition of the image reveals the outline of several ellipses.

This furniture is engraved with a representation of <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> brutally harming <color=#D09B61FF>Jason 'Jay' Andreas</color> out of bleak necessity. <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> looks pleased with the situation. The vertical structure of the image almost conflicts with its abstract style. Unusually for this kind of work, the subjects are in front of a group of pigs. This portrayal relates to the disabling of <color=#D09B61FF>Jay</color> by <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> on 11th of Jugust, 5502.
This furniture is engraved with a portrayal of thousands of howitzers. The scene takes place in the middle of a hamlet. The work is shaded in hues of white and black.

This furniture is engraved with a portrayal of <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> brutally knocking unconscious <color=#D09B61FF>Erika Valdez</color> with a gladius without emotion or expression. <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> looks pleased with the situation. This artwork relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> harming <color=#D09B61FF>Erika</color> with a gladius on 14th of Aprimay, 5502.

This furniture is engraved with an image of <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> sitting quietly, surrounded by a red aura. Five robbers are awestruck by the scene. The overall composition is well-balanced. This illustration tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> meditating on 13th of Aprimay, 5502.
This furniture bears a portrayal of a grassland.

An engraving on this furniture is shaped like <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> mutilating <color=#D09B61FF>a megascarab</color> with a gladius with quick, efficient movements. Dozens of meerkats look on. The work seems to represent struggle. This representation refers to the close combat slaying of <color=#D09B61FF>the megascarab</color> by <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> with a gladius on 5th of Jugust, 5502.

This furniture is engraved with an artwork of <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> ending <color=#D09B61FF>a megascarab</color>'s capacity for consciousness seemingly without remorse. <color=#D09B61FF>The megascarab</color> looks indebted. The work seems to express despair. Rounding out the work, the scene takes place on the outskirts of a hamlet. This representation relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> assassinating <color=#D09B61FF>the megascarab</color> on 5th of Jugust, 5502.

An engraving on this furniture depicts <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> elbow-deep in <color=#D09B61FF>Maisie Gould</color> during surgery with improvised but effective tools. <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> has blood smeared on her face. The scene takes place in the middle of a settlement. The image contrasts pain with vengeance. This image relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> operating on <color=#D09B61FF>Maisie</color> on 15th of Decembary, 5501.

This furniture bears an artwork of <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> ending <color=#D09B61FF>Freya 'Tail' Fairwing</color>'s capacity for consciousness with quick, efficient movements. <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> looks pleased with the situation. The scene takes place inside a town built near a field. The classical style of the central scene clashes with the amateurish yet attractive depiction of the background. This illustration relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> executing <color=#D09B61FF>Tail</color> on 9th of Decembary, 5501.
This furniture is engraved with a depiction of a line.

This furniture bears a representation of <color=#D09B61FF>Patrick 'Woodsy' Lomakina</color> building a multi-analyzer while smiling proudly. The multi-analyzer glows a soft orange. The image somehow expresses both confinement and challenge. As an interesting contrast, there is an archotech projection near the edge of the image. This artwork refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Woodsy</color> finishing construction on a multi-analyzer on 3rd of Jugust, 5502.
This furniture bears a representation of a cat holding a sword.
This weapon bears a portrayal of hundreds of pikes. The work suggests the concept of agony.

This furniture is engraved with a portrayal of <color=#D09B61FF>Niko Shmetlock</color> stumbling around with a completely broken expression on her face seemingly without reason. She looks happy and sad at the same time. Almost every shape in the image seems to be triangular. This artwork refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Niko</color> giving up in despair on 12th of Decembary, 5500.

This furniture bears a representation of <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> being harmed in a cowardly, halfhearted way. An archaeologist watches silently to the right of the main scene. This image tells the story of the wounding of <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> by <color=#D09B61FF>Scoop</color> on 4th of Decembary, 5500.

This furniture bears an artwork of <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> harming <color=#D09B61FF>a jaguar</color> with a knife without emotion or expression. <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> is baring her teeth. This depiction relates to the hurting of <color=#D09B61FF>the jaguar</color> on 6th of Decembary, 5500.

An engraving on this furniture is shaped like <color=#D09B61FF>Sycamore Guava</color> searching for water while vomiting. Three dessicated panther corpses surround the area. The lower part of the image is dominated by eight hearts. This artwork relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Sycamore</color> overheating on 9th of Septober, 5500.

This furniture is engraved with a representation of <color=#D09B61FF>Elm Palm</color> being crippled out of bleak necessity. A surgeon watches silently to the right of the main scene. This representation tells the story of the disabling of <color=#D09B61FF>Elm</color> on 11th of Decembary, 5500.

An engraving on this furniture depicts <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> murdering <color=#D09B61FF>Cuvin Fovnath</color> with a knife with quick, efficient movements. <color=#D09B61FF>Fovnath</color> is covered in innards. This image refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> mutilating <color=#D09B61FF>Fovnath</color> in melee with a knife on 1st of Septober, 5500.
On this piece is a depiction of a meadow. The image somehow expresses both confinement and god.

This furniture is engraved with an image of <color=#D09B61FF>Niko Shmetlock</color> brutally harming <color=#D09B61FF>Vivien Kant</color> with a human with quick, efficient movements. <color=#D09B61FF>Niko</color> looks triumphant. At the edge of the image are four cones. This illustration refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Niko</color> harming <color=#D09B61FF>Vivien</color> with a human on 5th of Decembary, 5500.
On this work is a depiction of a poet looking wise eating a pumpkin. The scene takes place on the outskirts of a city.

On this carving is an image of <color=#D09B61FF>Elm Palm</color> huddled in the shade of a tarpit and covered in sweat. The scene takes place inside a blazing desert. The work represents unrest. Though few would expect it, the image is bordered by two falcons. This illustration refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Elm</color> overheating on 4th of Septober, 5500.

This carving bears a depiction of <color=#D09B61FF>Patrick 'Woodsy' Lomakina</color> sitting in quiet contemplation, reflecting on the profound truths within Archaic Plate Armor while relaxing in his favorite reading nook. There is a sense that some secrets are yet to be uncovered. The work represents camraderie. Unusually for this kind of work, the subjects are in front of a devil. This artwork tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Woodsy</color> finishing Archaic Plate Armor on 13th of Septober, 5500.

This furniture bears a depiction of <color=#D09B61FF>Patrick 'Woodsy' Lomakina</color> gazing into the distance and surrounded by a white aura. Dozens of pirates are awestruck by the scene. The work has a heartfelt feeling and a triangular structure. This portrayal relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Woodsy</color> praying to a higher power on 5th of Decembary, 5500.

This furniture is engraved with an illustration of <color=#D09B61FF>Patrick 'Woodsy' Lomakina</color> searching for shade with cracked dry lips. The scene appears to take place inside, next to a heater. The work is executed in a minimalistic style. This artwork relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Woodsy</color> overheating on 7th of Decembary, 5500.
On this work is a representation of a goblin wearing a space suit. A city far from the main subject reminds the viewer of happiness.

This carving depicts <color=#D09B61FF>Patrick 'Woodsy' Lomakina</color> working feverishly with a familiar expression. His skill is visible in the work. A gaggle of grasshoppers in the lower part of the image seems to represent loneliness. This representation tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Woodsy</color> becoming a master at construction tasks on 3rd of Decembary, 5500.
This carving bears an artwork of a villager wearing a formal suit.
This furniture is engraved with an image of an empty evening gown.

This furniture is engraved with an illustration of <color=#D09B61FF>Sycamore Guava</color> sitting in quiet contemplation, reflecting on the profound truths within Archaic Plate Armor while relaxing in her favorite reading nook. <color=#D09B61FF>Sycamore</color> is surrounded by her notes on Archaic Plate Armor. This illustration tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Sycamore</color> finishing Archaic Plate Armor on 2nd of Decembary, 5501.

This furniture bears a depiction of <color=#D09B61FF>Sycamore Guava</color> elbow-deep in <color=#D09B61FF>Maisie Gould</color> during surgery as blood pools at <color=#D09B61FF>Sycamore</color>'s feet. <color=#D09B61FF>Maisie</color> is shaking and writhing. The style is erotic with dadaist elements. Provocatively, the image is bordered by thousands of triangles. This image refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Sycamore</color> performing a medical operation on <color=#D09B61FF>Maisie</color> on 11th of Decembary, 5501.

This furniture bears an artwork of ten farmers and blacksmiths eating peppers together. Dozens of archers appear in the distance. The pixelated style of the central scene clashes with the simple depiction of the background.
This furniture is engraved with a depiction of a badger eating a mushroom. The lower part of the image is dominated by six brigands.

This furniture is engraved with a representation of <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> sitting quietly, surrounded by a white aura. Eight rogues are awestruck by the scene. The lower part of the image is dominated by thousands of squares. The work symbolizes defeat. This image refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> meditating on 8th of Septober, 5501.
An engraving on this weapon depicts an abstracted rendering of death. The image somehow expresses both decency and friendship. The subjects are in front of a meerkat.

This piece bears a representation of <color=#D09B61FF>Patrick 'Woodsy' Lomakina</color> inscribing his name on a small sculpture while wiping the sweat from his forehead. The small sculpture glows a soft black. The work has a symbolic feeling and a square structure. In addition to that, ten vampires appear near the edge of the image. This depiction tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Woodsy</color> completing work on a small sculpture on 15th of Decembary, 5500.

This carving bears an image of <color=#D09B61FF>Bryan 'Scoop' Barnes</color> being slaughtered with a knife with quick, efficient movements. <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> looks pleased with the situation. The style is folksy with simple elements. This portrayal relates to the melee mutilating of <color=#D09B61FF>Scoop</color> by <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> on 4th of Decembary, 5500.
This carving bears a portrayal of a shaman wearing a power armor suit. The scene takes place inside a village built near a forest.

This furniture is engraved with a representation of <color=#D09B61FF>Jaegwang Sim</color> being harmed without emotion or expression. <color=#D09B61FF>Jaegwang</color> is wincing in pain. An ostrich fades in to the left of the main scene. The style is cel-shaded with modern elements. This depiction relates to <color=#D09B61FF>the rat</color> hurting <color=#D09B61FF>Jaegwang</color> on 7th of Decembary, 5500.

This furniture bears an artwork of seven automatons with glowing purple sensors attacking thousands of villagers. <color=#D09B61FF>Woodsy</color> wears an isolated expression. A terrorist in the distance seems to represent affection. The image somehow expresses both cataclysm and distance. This image relates to an ancient ship part landing near <color=#D09B61FF>Woodsy</color>'s town on 8th of Jugust, 5500.

An engraving on this furniture resembles <color=#D09B61FF>a carrier dryad</color> being disabled by <color=#D09B61FF>a megascarab</color> in a cowardly, halfhearted way. <color=#D09B61FF>The megascarab</color> looks pleased with the situation. The lower part of the image is dominated by ten archaeologists. This illustration tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>the megascarab</color> disabling <color=#D09B61FF>the carrier dryad</color> with a megascarab on 5th of Jugust, 5502.

An engraving on this furniture resembles <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> tying <color=#D09B61FF>Vivien Kant</color>'s hands as she writhes on the ground. <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> is twisting <color=#D09B61FF>Vivien</color>'s ear. This depiction refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> capturing <color=#D09B61FF>Vivien</color> on 1st of Decembary, 5500.
An engraving on this furniture portrays a field. The whole image is depicted by the careful arrangement of nine hackers.

This sculpture bears an image of <color=#D09B61FF>Itterk Yaesh</color> being incapacitated out of bleak necessity. <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> is baring her teeth. This portrayal refers to the disabling of <color=#D09B61FF>Itterk</color> with a knife on 7th of Septober, 5500.

On this sculpture is an artwork of <color=#D09B61FF>Jaegwang Sim</color> polishing the surface of a small sculpture while covered in grime. A thousand sheriffs marvel at the device. The lower part of the image is dominated by a forest. This depiction relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Jaegwang</color> completing work on a small sculpture on 14th of Decembary, 5500.

An engraving on this furniture represents a salmon riding on a stingray wearing a formal suit surrounded by hypnotists. The work makes the viewer think of love. At the edge of the image are a thousand beasts.

On this sculpture is a portrayal of <color=#D09B61FF>Niko Shmetlock</color> looking into the sky and radiating serenity. She is surrounded by ten cheetahs. A ferret floats in the upper part of the image. The work is shaded in hues of white and orange. This illustration relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Niko</color> praying to a higher power on 6th of Jugust, 5501.

This furniture is engraved with an artwork of <color=#D09B61FF>Patrick 'Woodsy' Woods</color> whispering sweet nothings into <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color>'s ear between the sheets. <color=#D09B61FF>Woodsy</color> is touching <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> aggressively. The scene takes place on the outskirts of a township. The work reminds the viewer of confinement. This illustration tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Woodsy</color> and <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> becoming lovers on 1st of Aprimay, 5500.

This furniture bears an artwork of ten raiders advancing over a bramble. Three engineers flee the area. A bee stands far from the main subject. The work seems to symbolize war. This illustration relates to an raid on <color=#D09B61FF>Elm</color>'s campsite on 1st of Septober, 5500.
An engraving on this furniture shows eight town guards and chemists eating cauliflowers together. The work conveys the emotions of desire.

On this sculpture is a representation of <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> sitting quietly, glowing softly. Seven newts rest peacefully. The work is infused with the idea of poverty and is done in a post-impressionistic style. Provocatively, the scene takes place in the middle of a town. This artwork tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> meditating on 10th of Aprimay, 5502.

This piece bears a depiction of <color=#D09B61FF>Zeyu 'Zihao' Fu</color> crouching next to a fire while her face slowly turns blue. <color=#D09B61FF>Zihao</color>'s clothes are tattered and worn. The work is shaded in hues of blue and blue. Rounding out the work, the scene takes place in the middle of a town. This depiction tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Zihao</color> getting hypothermia on 3rd of Septober, 5502.

This work bears an artwork of <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna Lomakina</color> eliminating <color=#D09B61FF>a lemur</color>'s capacity for blood pumping without emotion or expression. <color=#D09B61FF>The lemur</color> looks helpless. The whole image is depicted by the careful arrangement of a large group of peppers. The overall composition is vertical. This portrayal tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Maryna</color> slaying <color=#D09B61FF>the lemur</color> on 4th of Septober, 5502.

This piece bears an image of <color=#D09B61FF>Elm Palm</color> turning the pages of Archaic Plate Armor, absorbing the knowledge within with a cup of tea by her side. <color=#D09B61FF>Elm</color> is surrounded by her notes on Archaic Plate Armor. This illustration relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Elm</color> finishing Archaic Plate Armor on 8th of Jugust, 5502.

On this piece is a depiction of <color=#D09B61FF>Allen Giles</color> adding surface detail to a small sculpture with a satisfied expression on his face. The small sculpture is intricately detailed. The work symbolizes loyalty. This depiction relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Allen</color> completing work on a small sculpture on 9th of Septober, 5502.
This carving bears a representation of a solitary dragon moving to the left. The image is bordered by several sheriffs.

This sculpture resembles <color=#D09B61FF>Allen Giles</color> inscribing his name on a small sculpture while covered in grime. The small sculpture is intricately detailed. There is a criminal in the background. The work seems to symbolize difficulty. This image refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Allen</color> completing work on a small sculpture on 13th of Jugust, 5502.

On this sculpture is a portrayal of a snake holding a rocket. A pack of vultures to the right of the main scene represents pain. The rectangular structure of the image almost conflicts with its erotic style.
This piece shows a thicket. The work conveys the emotions of solidarity.

This work portrays <color=#D09B61FF>Zeyu 'Zihao' Fu</color> elbow-deep in <color=#D09B61FF>Ak Gutzik</color> during surgery while surrounded by scary-looking surgical tools. <color=#D09B61FF>Zihao</color> has blood smeared on her face. The work reminds the viewer of desire. The whole image is depicted by the careful arrangement of a large group of cabbages. This portrayal tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Ak</color>'s medical operation on 15th of Aprimay, 5502.
